title: What If All the Gold Ever Mined Became One Cube?

scenes.text: What if every ounce of gold ever mined melted into one cube? It's smaller than you'd think.
Humans have mined more than 200,000 tonnes of gold since the beginning of history.
Melt it all down and the cube is only about 22 meters on each side.
Nearly half of it, about 45 percent, is jewelry. Central banks hold another 18 percent.
At recent prices, that cube would be worth roughly 29 trillion dollars.
And about 61,000 tonnes of reserves remain underground, enough for a second cube about two thirds as wide.
